note: FILL_UNTIL_END and FILL_UNTIL_MAX_SIZE are reserved standardized semantics, not stated as the only rule values.
Arguments beyond array length are ignored rather than invalid.
Variant compound primitive initValue supplies the maximum possible amount of values.
Variant compound primitive initValue size must cover the SwSystemconst range.
Bound-model tools truncate initValues to the lower part when actual size is smaller.
SwAxisCont has one swAxisIndex and one swArraySize per dimension.
Listed application value categories require swArraySize in SwValueCont.
Bound swValuesPhys descendant count equals product of swArraySize values and target prototype element count.
NumericalOrText defines exactly one of vf or vt.
Lower-priority initial value definitions are ignored.
Compute effective initial value using prototype, ComSpec, then calibration-value precedence.
Interpret initValue physically for ApplicationDataType and numerically for ImplementationDataType.
VALUE application primitive initValues are physical values processed through CompuMethod.
Compound primitive numerical initValue representation must match mapped ImplementationDataType and optional constant mapping.
Application primitive prototype initValue uses ApplicationValueSpecification and enumeration text must match a CompuScale label.
Implementation-typed prototype initValue cannot use ApplicationValueSpecification.
STRING target requires ApplicationValueSpecification category STRING.
ApplicationRecordDataType initValue uses RecordValueSpecification.
ApplicationArrayDataType initValue uses ArrayValueSpecification or ApplicationRuleBasedValueSpecification.
Each constant mapping pairs one application-domain and one implementation-domain ConstantSpecification.
ParameterSwComponentType directly associates the applicable ConstantSpecificationMappingSet.
NvBlockSwComponentType associates ConstantSpecificationMappingSet through its NvBlockDescriptor.
